trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. No online play or DLC is needed; the long pole is the 100% checklist behind A Long Road.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when you finish Gone Fishing, the first mission of Chapter 1.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops once Chapter 1 is done — PowerPyx notes it lands after the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops once Chapter 2 is done — PowerPyx notes it lands after the first mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops once Chapter 3 is done — PowerPyx notes it lands after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops once Chapter 4 is done, after its final mission, Starting From Zero.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops when you finish the final mission of the game, which also opens free roam for the cleanup.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops during the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops during the Chapter 3 mission The Cartel Heist.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops during the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops during the Chapter 4 mission Headliners.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops during the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops during the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy on the list. After the story, open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion: the checklist appears there, and everything you did during the story already counts toward it. The requirements are forgiving — PowerPyx calls it closer to 60% true completion — but you still need every robbery, underwater discovery, shooting range, drone race and Bret quest, plus 70 of the 80 challenges.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Mix the categories and pick the quickest ones for you — PowerPyx says the under-bridge flights are fastest. For the 100% checklist you need 300, so keep going past 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt. Track them under Progress, then Activities. You will do most of them naturally while chasing the other trophies.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across the 12 ranges. The medals are not too hard, per PowerPyx — take them steadily as you unlock ranges rather than leaving all 42 for the end.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. Drone races are part of the 100% checklist too, so every win does double duty.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Races count toward the 100% checklist as well, so work through race types you have not tried yet instead of repeating one you like.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is one of the 9 activity types, so the challenge also feeds Master of None — learn the fishing timing first, then take Cal on.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Arcade machines are scattered around Leonida; any finished game counts, so pick the shortest one you find.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's last mission. Andy's strand is one of the character questlines — keep doing his missions as they appear and the final one pops this trophy.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's last mission. Kenton can be temporarily unavailable during the story, but every trophy quest giver comes back in free roam after the ending, so you cannot lock this out.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's last mission. Work through Billy's strand as its missions appear.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. These are not needed for the 100% checklist, so they are usually what is left after Step 2 of the roadmap — save them for the cleanup pass.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's last mission. Randy's strand also feeds the 100% checklist through his vehicle deliveries.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's last mission. Tyrone's strand is Jason-only, so play his missions as Jason.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida — and do the first one in Chapter 1, or it is gone. After the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth, find Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house in the morning: she mentions meditating, walks to the balcony, and you follow and choose Accept. PowerPyx notes it is still unclear whether that balcony meditation counts toward the 18, so do it anyway. The last spot needs Jason and Lucia playable together, which opens after Chapter 2.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's quests are one of the few things the 100% checklist needs in full, so do his strand as it opens. Study animals through the binoculars first — studying, not hunting, is what the checklist counts for the 100 you need.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. There are 18 sets in the game, and the 100% checklist needs 15 of them, so keep collecting past the third set.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app at 100 locations: landmarks, curiosities and sculptures. Scanning vehicles with WAiNK also feeds the 100% checklist's 200-vehicle target, so scan everything new you pass.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges. You only need 70 of the 80 for the 100% checklist, so you can skip the nastiest ones entirely — pick the 50 that suit how you play.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level and then lose the heat and escape. A quiet stretch of road and a fast car make the escape far easier than doing it in the middle of Vice City.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Keep the wanted level alive between shops and move fast — if the heat drops, the chain breaks.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. A WAiNK scan is enough to count a vehicle as discovered, so scan every new model you see rather than stealing each one.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during a single use of Combat Focus. Pick a fight with a group clustered together so one slow-motion window is enough for all five.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — leave the airport by a route the game did not plan for you. PowerPyx's guide shows the airport run, so check its screenshots if the trigger is unclear.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a tank from Mile Zero Air Station and take out enemies from inside it. GTABase reports the method; treat it as a lead from one guide, not a confirmed step, until more players repeat it.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet, avoid the cameras and guards, and leave before anyone raises the alarm.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Bank vault robberies are also part of the 100% checklist, so each one counts twice.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks run set routes around Leonida; hit one away from heavy police patrols and have an escape car ready.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. The in-game map keeps revealing named areas as you visit them — drive, fly and sail into every corner until no new names appear.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Every gang needs one hit, and gang operations are part of the 100% checklist, so this trophy and the checklist advance together.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: No verified method yet. The description says to enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, but as of 19 November 2026 no guide has pinned down the exact trigger. This guide will not invent one — check the cited pages again after launch-week players crack it.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: No verified method yet. GTABase suggests crashing a car out through a vehicle showroom window, but that is unconfirmed. The description says to smash your way out in classic style — treat the showroom idea as a lead, not a step.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: The description points to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley, but the exact follow-through is not yet pinned down by the guides checked — EGamers lists it as wording unclear. Go to the alley and try a full game; this guide will update the steps once a guide confirms them.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reported, not yet widely confirmed: GTABase says to max out Strength for both Jason and Lucia. Going to the gym together helps — while one character works out, the other trains automatically, so progress doubles. Treat this as a lead until a second guide confirms it.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Reported by one guide so far: GTABase says to perform 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Play normally and the count climbs on its own; this guide marks it single-source until another guide confirms the number.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: No verified method yet. The description — Second time's the charm — hints at succeeding on a second attempt, but no guide has confirmed what to retry. This guide will not invent a step.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: No verified method yet. GTABase suggests it refers to a strange event somewhere in Leonida, but nothing is confirmed. The description asks What the hell just happened? — if you see something odd in the open world, it may be this one.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: The description says to bowl someone over with a melee drive-by, but the exact trigger is still unconfirmed. Try it near the bowling alley and watch for the pop — this guide will update once a guide confirms the steps.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies; launder them steadily through contacts rather than sitting on a pile.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Normal play gets you much of the way there — vehicles, clothes and gear all count — and the garages for Little Boxes help too.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Push Square puts the total at $160,000 for all eight, adding 8 vehicle storage slots — buy them as your money allows.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Register cars as you find them rather than waiting for a special trip — ten registrations is quick once you are driving around anyway.
